statement: Post-analysis of frozen compact packed indexed N24 disassembly finds normalized PairTable probe117 instruction lines and PairWitnessMap get135 instruction lines identical across all3 controls after ignoring branch-address and RIP-displacement relocations and comments, retaining padding. Probe start modulo64 is48/0/16 and lookup48/32/16. This is normalized assembly-text equality, not byte/data/cache equivalence or a causal timing verdict. Inputs and normalizer hashes recorded; no new native measurement.
